violation_type.title: Parent Provided Snacks - May be Shared with Other Children if for Celebration or Party at Center (26 TAC §746.3309(d)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Parent Provided Snacks - May be Shared with Other Children if for Celebration or Party at Center
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver was reported to have shared their child's food with another child without parent's permission.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver was reported to have shared their child's food with another child without parent's permission.
Based on the information obtained from the investigation, it is confirmed that snacks provided by parents are shared with other children on a daily basis.
